title: Alert fatigue is breaking compliance. Theta Lake has a fix
hook_text: Up to 99 percent are false positives
script:
Up to ninety-nine percent of lexicon hits turn out to be false positives.
Theta Lake released a new suite designed to tackle alert fatigue in compliance.
Traditional surveillance methods rely on rigid keyword searches that trigger endless noise.
The new suite uses advanced AI to automate reviews and cut through the noise.
Organizations can now streamline workflows instead of wasting hours on bad alerts.
Would you trust AI to handle your firm compliance review?
